{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Water| type2=Flying| ball=None| nickname=Pelipper| jnickname=ペリッパ| tmnickname=Pelipper| image=[[File:Pelipper RTDX.png|300px]]| caption=Pelipper in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]]| caught=no | gender=Male | ability=Unknown| pokemonname=Pelipper| prevonum=279| noevo=incap | epnum= Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team | current=At {{DL|Pokémon Square|Pelipper Post Office}} | media=anime| java1=N/A| enva1=Unknown| }} '''Pelipper''' (Japanese: '''ペリッパ''' ''Pelipper'') is a [[non-player character]] in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team]], and their [[remake]] [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]]. ==In the games== [[File:Pelipper Mystery Dungeon Red and Blue.png|200px|left|thumb|The {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] speak to Pelipper in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team]]]] A certain Pelipper delivers mail to the {{pkmn2|hero}}'s rescue base. After the hero tells the [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] that the balance of the world is in space, the partner asks Pelipper to take them into space. Pelipper tells them "no way" before flying off again. He then later leaves a letter for the hero and partner before they go on the run as fugitives to say goodbye to them. He was then happy to be delivering mail to them again once the hero and partner returned, delivering a breaking news post to [[Pokémon Square]] to tell everyone of the hero's innocence. {{left clear}} ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{water color}}; font-size:80%;" |- |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}; width:120px"| [[File:MDP RT 279.png]] |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}; width:200px"| [[File:MDP RTDX 279.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 279 Grin.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 279 Pained.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 279 Worried.png|40px]] |- | Portrait from

{{color2|000|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Pelipper PMD anime.png|thumb|250px|Pelipper in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'']] Pelipper appeared in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]''. He first appeared in the beginning, flying over {{p|Charmander}} and {{p|Squirtle}} of the later formed [[Team Go-Getters]] during their first meeting. He then appeared in the end, flying over to the {{DL|Pokémon Square|Pelipper Post Office}} as Team Go-Getters watched on.
